tasks.spec:
You are a Python engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, NEVER call a model, NEVER use the network, NEVER run npm, playwright or the bench. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv . Ruff: `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` (line length 120, double quotes, Python 3.12, standard library only). Never pass --cov to pytest. Run tests as `PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 <test files>`.

BACKGROUND. The dark factory line (`factory/line.py`, `FactoryLine`) drives tickets through fixed stations; a handler is `Callable[[Ticket, datetime], StationResult]`, and `StationResult(passed, check, output, tokens=0, turns=None, routing=None)`. Station 8 (`factory/stations/triage.py`) routes failing-turn packets (the format is `_DEFAULTS` and `_validate_packet` there) to a class. Station 7 (`Station.LIVE_PLAYTEST`) has no handler yet. A failed station 7 result that carries `turns` (a non-empty list of packets) moves the ticket to triage; a pass skips triage. Read `factory/line.py`, `factory/tickets.py`, `factory/stations/triage.py`, `factory/stations/free_gates.py` (the handler style, injectable runner, env handling), `factory/stations/__init__.py` (`build_handlers`), `factory/guard.py` and `factory/limits.py`, and `tests/test_factory_triage.py` and `tests/test_factory_stations.py`, first.

WHAT STATION 7 RUNS (read-only facts; you do not run it). The live playtest is the hosted blind player: `frontend/e2e/blind-player.spec.js` (tag `@blind-player`), run on STAGING only with `source .env && cd frontend && E2E_BLIND_SCENE=<scene> BLIND_PLAYER_PROFILE=<canonical|raw> E2E_BLIND_REPLICATES=<n> E2E_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS=90000 npm run test:e2e -- --grep @blind-player`. A scene other than 1A is reached by a scripted prefix inside the spec. It spends real money (an OpenAI blind player plus Cloudflare narration). It writes `artifacts/e2e-blind-player.json` (single replicate; `-r1` and so on for several), plus `e2e-blind-player-bundles.json` and `e2e-blind-player-prompts.json`. Staging identity is `GET $E2E_API_BASE_URL/api/v1/version`, which must report `channel: "staging"`, `runtime: "scene-v1"` and the expected `sha`. Report shape (read a real one: `bench/results/stage7-blind-raw-pr670/attempt-1/e2e-blind-player.json`, which has a stuck turn, and `bench/results/stage7-2b-entry/attempt-1/e2e-blind-player.json`): top level `story_id`, `scene`, `profile`, `ending_reached`, `replicates[]`; each replicate has `replicate`, `scenes[]`, `stopped_reason`; each scene run has `scene`, `turns[]` (keys `turn`, `input`, `raw_input`, `text`, `rejected`, `rejection`, `story_complete`, `scene_id`, `semantic_match`, `grounding_ids`, `transition_cause`, `outcome`, `game_break`), `turn_count`, `stuck_turns` (turn numbers), `stuck_runs`, `rejected_turns`, `rejected_count`, `game_break_count`, `exit_cause`, `transition_fired`, `affordances`, `stopped_on_rejections`.

BUILD `factory/stations/live_playtest.py`:
1. `report_to_packets(report: dict, *, key_prefix: str = "") -> list[dict]`: pure and deterministic. One failing-turn packet per FAILING turn, never one per turn. A turn fails when its number is in the scene run's `stuck_turns`, or it is `rejected`, or its `game_break` is not None, or its `outcome` is not `committed` (read the real reports to see what outcomes exist and list them in NOTES_15A.txt). Packet keys follow triage `_DEFAULTS`: `key` = `f"{prefix}{scene}-r{replicate}-t{turn}"`, `scene`, `player_input` (the raw input), `narration` (the turn text), `stuck` (turn is in `stuck_turns`), and the rest from what the report actually records. Do not invent evidence: leave a field at its default when the report has no value for it, and say in NOTES_15A.txt which fields the report cannot fill (for example `candidates_offered`, `committed`, `engine_error`, `flags`) and what that does to triage routing (a stuck turn with no candidates routes to story_data by rule R2; if that would misroute a turn the report shows was matched and committed, choose the conservative mapping and record it). A turn whose `rejection` text is present goes into `match_issues` as a string. Malformed or missing parts never raise: skip the replicate or scene and keep going.
2. `playtest_summary(report: dict) -> dict`: per run counts the gates need: `turns`, `stuck_turns`, `rejected`, `game_breaks`, `exit_cause`, `transition_fired`, `scenes`, `ending_reached`. The gate for station 7 is ZERO stuck turns and every run leaving the scene by an earned (non-timeout, non-forced) transition: read how `exit_cause` and `transition_cause` name those in the real reports, and write the rule as a small documented constant. A report with no runs fails.
3. `live_playtest_handler(root: Path | None = None, *, runner: Callable[..., ...] | None = None, now_fn=...) -> StationHandler`. Payload keys (document them in the module docstring): `scene` (default the ticket's scene), `expected_sha`, `profile` (default `canonical`), `replicates` (default 1, cap at 3 for this handler), `report_path` (when present, grade this saved report and call NOTHING; this is the free path and the one the tests use). Without `report_path`, the handler must (a) read `$E2E_API_BASE_URL/api/v1/version` through an injectable `fetch_version` callable and fail BEFORE any billed step unless channel is staging, runtime is scene-v1 and the sha equals `expected_sha` (an absent expected_sha fails too); (b) run the playtest through the injectable `runner(env: dict, timeout_s: int) -> subprocess-like result` EXACTLY ONCE per call, never retrying inside the handler; (c) read the fresh report from `artifacts/e2e-blind-player*.json` newer than the start of the run (delete stale ones first), failing with a clear line when none exists. The default runner builds the npm command from the payload, passes `E2E_BLIND_SCENE`, `BLIND_PLAYER_PROFILE`, `E2E_BLIND_REPLICATES`, `E2E_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS=90000` in the environment, never prints or logs any environment value that is not one of those four, and uses a timeout of 2400 s per replicate. HOWEVER: the default runner must refuse to run (raise a clear error that the handler turns into a failed result with no turns) unless the payload carries `"billed_run_approved": true`; every test uses a stub and none sets the approval on a real runner. Quota stops are not failures of the story: a run whose output mentions `AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` or `AI_DAILY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED`, or an HTTP 429, must raise `factory.guard`'s existing limit exception in the way the other guarded calls do (read `guard.py` and `limits.py` for the exact class and how `ProviderLimit` carries `provider` and a reset: Cloudflare quota clears at 00:00 UTC), never a failed attempt and never turns. Use the provider name `cloudflare` for the Cloudflare limit.
4. Result mapping: pass -> `StationResult(True, "live_playtest", summary_line)`; story failure (stuck turns, forced or timer exit, rejections) -> `StationResult(False, "live_playtest", summary_line, turns=packets)` with the packets from `report_to_packets` (non-empty); infrastructure failure (wrong identity, no report, runner error, unreadable report) -> `StationResult(False, ..., turns=None)` so the line's normal retry ladder applies. The output text is short: counts and the failing keys, never narration.
5. Register it: `factory/stations/__init__.py` `build_handlers()` returns it for `Station.LIVE_PLAYTEST` beside the existing stations (2, 5, 6, 8). Keep the existing behaviour and the lazy-import style that file already uses; add to its tests only through the new test file.
6. A CLI `python -m factory.stations.live_playtest grade REPORT.json [--scene S]` prints the summary and the packets as JSON and exits 0 when the gate passes, 1 on story failure, 2 on bad input. It never calls the runner.

FIXTURE AND TESTS. Create `tests/fixtures/factory/blind_player_report_small.json`: a hand-trimmed report (a few KB at most) with three runs shaped like the real ones: one clean scene exit, one with a stuck turn, one with a rejected turn and a game break; narration strings shortened but real in shape. Do not copy a whole saved report. Create `tests/test_factory_live_playtest.py`: packets for each failing kind with the exact keys and defaults; no packet for passing turns; every produced packet passes triage `_validate_packet` and `classify_turns` returns a class for each (assert the class you documented, not just "any"); summary counts; the gate (clean pass, stuck fail, timer or forced exit fail, empty report fail); handler on `report_path` for pass, story failure with turns, bad file without turns; handler live path with stubbed `fetch_version` and `runner`: wrong channel, wrong sha, missing expected_sha each fail with the runner NEVER called; runner called exactly once on success; stale artifact ignored; no fresh report fails without turns; the default runner refuses without `billed_run_approved`; a quota text raises the guard's limit exception for provider cloudflare and the result is never a counted failure; the CLI exit codes; `build_handlers()` includes station 7. TIME BUDGET: the new test file runs in under 10 seconds, with small literal data, tmp_path and stubs only, no network, no subprocess to npm.

HARD LIMITS. Edit only the five files above (create the fixtures directory if absent). Never edit `frontend/`, `bench/`, `factory/config/`, `factory/guard.py`, `factory/limits.py`, `factory/line.py`, `factory/tickets.py`, `factory/stations/triage.py` or any other module or test, and add no dependencies. Add the new test file's entry to `tests/shard_durations.json` by running `PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src .venv/bin/python scripts/regen_shard_durations.py --missing-only` (it must change only that file's entry). Write NOTES_15A.txt (worktree root, never committed) listing every rule you found ambiguous and the choice you made, the report fields that cannot fill packet fields, and which provider names the factory.json and guard know (the blind player's OpenAI spend has no entry there; say what you found and do not edit config).
tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-station7
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git add -A -- factory tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -vxF -e factory/stations/live_playtest.py -e factory/stations/__init__.py -e tests/test_factory_live_playtest.py -e tests/fixtures/factory/blind_player_report_small.json -e tests/shard_durations.json || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
for f in factory/stations/live_playtest.py tests/test_factory_live_playtest.py tests/fixtures/factory/blind_player_report_small.json; do [ -s "$f" ] || { echo "missing $f"; exit 1; }; done
grep -q 'test_factory_live_playtest.py' tests/shard_durations.json || { echo "tests/shard_durations.json has no entry for test_factory_live_playtest.py"; exit 1; }
size=$(wc -c < tests/fixtures/factory/blind_player_report_small.json)
[ "$size" -le 20000 ] || { echo "fixture is $size bytes, over the 20000 limit"; exit 1; }
if grep -n -i -E "import (openai|anthropic|requests|httpx)|from (openai|anthropic|requests|httpx)" factory/stations/live_playtest.py; then echo "live_playtest.py must not import a model client or an http library"; exit 1; fi
start=$(date +%s)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 tests/test_factory_live_playtest.py
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "station 7 tests took $took s (budget 20 s)"
[ "$took" -le 20 ] || { echo "station 7 tests over the 20 s budget"; exit 1; }
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 tests/test_factory_stations.py tests/test_factory_triage.py tests/test_factory_line.py tests/test_factory_followups.py tests/test_factory_frozen.py tests/test_factory_entry.py tests/test_regen_shard_durations.py
.venv/bin/python -m ruff check factory/stations tests/test_factory_live_playtest.py
.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check factory/stations tests/test_factory_live_playtest.py
# independent probe on REAL saved reports: the converter and the gate, no runner
probe="$WORK/out/probe.out"
: > "$probe"
.venv/bin/python -m factory.stations.live_playtest grade /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/stage7-blind-raw-pr670/attempt-1/e2e-blind-player.json >> "$probe" 2>&1 && { echo "pr670 report has a stuck turn and must FAIL the gate"; cat "$probe"; exit 1; } || [ $? -eq 1 ] || { echo "grade exit was not 1 for the stuck report"; cat "$probe"; exit 1; }
.venv/bin/python - >> "$probe" 2>&1 <<'PY'
import json
from factory.stations.live_playtest import report_to_packets, playtest_summary
from factory.stations.triage import classify_turns
real = json.load(open("/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/stage7-blind-raw-pr670/attempt-1/e2e-blind-player.json"))
packets = report_to_packets(real)
assert packets, "the stuck report must yield packets"
stuck = [p for p in packets if p["stuck"]]
assert stuck, "a stuck turn must produce a stuck packet"
routed = classify_turns(packets)
assert len(routed) == len(packets)
turns_total = sum(len(s["turns"]) for r in real["replicates"] for s in r["scenes"])
assert len(packets) < turns_total, "passing turns must not become packets"
print("packets", len(packets), "of", turns_total, "turns; routed", [r["class"] for r in routed])
clean = json.load(open("/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/stage7-2b-entry/attempt-1/e2e-blind-player.json"))
print("clean summary", playtest_summary(clean))
print("probe ok")
PY
cat "$probe"
grep -q "probe ok" "$probe" || { echo "probe failed"; exit 1; }
git diff --cached > $WORK/out/station7.patch
test -s $WORK/out/station7.patch
